html.Записи: ручей – jackthemurray (CC0); шел: Recordings: stream - jackthemurray (CC0); rustling leaves - Gravity Sound (CC BY 4.0, trimmed and volume-leveled); both via Wikimedia Commons. The other sounds are synthesized on the page itself.
html.Нажми на звук, чтобы добавить его в смес: Click a sound to add it to the mix; each has its own volume, and the sounds layer on top of each other.
html.Направление из Life Reset – время по нем: Direction from Life Reset - the time will be counted from it
html.Научная основа есть только у ровного шум: Only steady noise has scientific backing: a 2024 meta-analysis found that white and pink noise slightly improve attention in ADHD (a small effect, in lab tasks), while it may get in the way for people without ADHD; brown noise has not been tested directly. Waterfall, stream, leaves, wind, rain and purring are added for taste and have no such backing for ADHD: pick what you enjoy and what does not distract you. Keep it quiet so the sound stays in the background and does not become a second distraction.
html.Язык задан переменной LOCAL_COACH_LANG и: The language is set by the LOCAL_COACH_LANG variable and cannot be changed here.
